sources: https://www.edgeley.com/weaver-park-pool-and-campground ('The Edgeley Campground is made up of three locations. The original Campground which was built in 1985 is located on the North Side of the Park with Fifteen full service sites available. In 1999 a new campground was added across from the park to the East with Thirteen full service sites available. Also in 1999 a location next to the Edgeley Ambulance building was added. This location is generally used for extended camping or if someone would like more privacy. All sites have electricity, Water, Sewer and Wifi. Several 50 Amp service locations are available for larger campers. Fees are $20 per night. Monthly rates are also available for extended visits at a rate of $450 per month.'; 'Generally from April to November bathroom and shower facilities are open for use.'; 'The campground located on the north and east sides of the pool is open from early Spring to late Fall.'; 'Make reservations at the Campground by clicking here.' -> https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/EdgeleyCampground), read 2026-11-12

note: City of Edgeley campground at the north end of Main Street by Weaver Park and its pool, in three parts: the original loop on the north side of the park, a second area across to the east, and a few sites by the ambulance building used mostly for extended stays. --Claude
summary: City page + Firefly read: 15 + 13 full-service sites (E/W/S, some 50A, wifi), $20/night, $450/month, Firefly online booking (reCAPTCHA on search, quotes unread), season Apr 15-Oct 1. Count 15 -> 28; Dyrt-derived 40-ft max and dump cleared; booking/season added. Pin ok on the north loop. Website: drop The Dyrt, add Firefly. Phone -> City Hall 701-493-2208.
flags: WEBSITE: 'https://www.edgeley.com/weaver-park-pool-and-campground\nhttps://thedyrt.com/camping/north-dakota/edgeley-campground' -> 'https://www.edgeley.com/weaver-park-pool-and-campground\nhttps://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/EdgeleyCampground' (The Dyrt is an aggregator; Firefly is the city's booking engine, linked from its page).
PHONE: none stored -> 701-493-2208 (City of Edgeley City Hall, edgeley.com/city-hall; the campground page says to contact City Hall at city@edgeley.com).
GOOGLE: 'Edgeley Campground' 4.5 stars / 15 reviews, phone 701-493-2208 (same as City Hall), pin 46.36318,-98.71261 (~15 m from the stored pin).

PIN: stored 46.36330,-98.71268 sits inside the original campground loop (units visible on imagery) north of the street across from the pool and park: ok. The east area (13 sites) is across Main Street ~100-150 m east; not moved.
OWNERSHIP: City of Edgeley runs it on its page; HHS licenses it to the Edgeley Park District (28 lots). local stands.
FIT: no length posted anywhere; full-service sites with 'Several 50 Amp service locations ... for larger campers' (city page). Firefly's equipment list includes Motorhome Class C. No fit doubt.

LONG-STAY: nightly $20 and monthly $450 are both posted and booked online; Firefly offers a 'Short Term Only' class filter and an Ongoing (pay monthly) type, and the third (ambulance) area is 'generally used for extended camping'. The two main areas (28 sites) are not described as seasonal. Nightly share could not be measured (Firefly search behind reCAPTCHA). Not a seasonal-lease park on the page's wording; keep.
UNREAD: Firefly site list, per-site lengths and quotes (reCAPTCHA checkbox on search; not routed around).

HORSES (AWH rule 2026-11-12): the city campground page and Firefly listing are silent on horses. Imagery shows an oval track/arena ~300 m north of the loop across open ground, apparently separate grounds; no horse facilities among the sites. Not a horse campground; keep.
